findings.environment: Render + Mobile release APK + Web production
findings.summary: Free-plan cold start ~60s vs 15s mobile client timeout guarantees first-request failure after idle (blank screens, login hangs)
findings.reproduction: Leave backend idle >15min; GET /health times out at 60s, retry answers in 0.3s
findings.actual: TimeoutException on every initial mobile request; occasional 504 via website
findings.root_cause: Render free plan sleeps instance; ApiClient hard 15s timeout; no keepalive
findings.fix: ApiClient wake-and-retry (75s /health ping, 30s retry); website login retry with waking banner; GitHub Actions keepalive every 10min; recommend paid plan
findings.test: Idle backend, fresh APK login succeeds; website login shows waking banner then succeeds

findings.summary: Firestore-only memberships have no Postgres members row; all resident_pg endpoints 403 'No active membership' (parcels 500)
findings.root_cause: Dual data store; approval/login flows write Firestore only; ResidentService.resolveContext requires approved Postgres members row
findings.fix: resolveContext lazily provisions members row from JWT society scope (resident roles only); wired through resident_pg, parcels_pg, domestic_help_pg

findings.summary: Superadmin website login 'not working': login form pre-fills society-admin account; Super Admin tab submit returns PORTAL_MISMATCH; superadmin creds never documented
findings.reproduction: Open /login, click Super Admin, submit prefilled 9200000001/123456
findings.actual: 403 'This account does not have access to the selected portal'
findings.root_cause: Static prefill + undocumented credentials (superadmin/123456, account superadmin-001); backend flow verified correct
findings.fix: Per-portal demo prefill+hint in login page; credentials recorded in LOGIN_CREDENTIALS_CHECKLIST.md
findings.test: Super Admin tab -> sign in -> /super-admin/dashboard 200 (verified live via BFF with real creds)

findings.summary: Local .env DATABASE_URL points at stopped Docker Postgres (localhost:5544); empty-message connection errors in local shell
findings.fix: Start Docker Desktop; docker compose up -d with PG_USER/PG_DATABASE/PG_PASSWORD set

findings.summary: CORS_ORIGINS='*' compared literally in server.js -> matches no browser origin (latent; BFF architecture masks it)
findings.fix: render.yaml now lists CloudFront + localhost origins

findings.summary: Git split-brain: Render deploys branch render-live; GitHub master is an unrelated stale history (2026-06-21); local master (canonical) can't fast-forward push; keepalive cron won't run until default branch carries it
findings.fix: Owner decision required: force-push local master (archive old first) or adopt render-live as canonical; deploy command prepared

findings.summary: Demo credentials displayed on public login page; real AI keys in local .env.local; second undocumented super_admin account exists
findings.fix: Remove hints + rotate before real-customer production; audit account uF8Tyx2aVZqHzIsm8NDM
